policy: Anti-patterns are hypotheses, never automatic defects. Verify task, intent, implementation and user impact before reporting.

antiPatterns.name: Generic gradient wash
antiPatterns.summary: Brandless gradients used to make an interface look modern.
antiPatterns.trigger: Palette and hero rely on gradient unrelated to product or identity.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use authentic product imagery, relevant diagram or meaningful geometry.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Gradients are valid when they belong to the brand.

antiPatterns.name: Glassmorphism everywhere
antiPatterns.summary: Blurred translucent panels applied to most surfaces.
antiPatterns.trigger: Most containers rely on blur, transparency and glow.
antiPatterns.impact: Layering can harm legibility, performance and hierarchy.
antiPatterns.alternative: Reserve translucency for a few layered surfaces with verified contrast.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Glass can suit overlays and spatial depth.

antiPatterns.name: Three equal cards by default
antiPatterns.summary: Repeated triads without evidence that content is comparable.
antiPatterns.trigger: Same card row appears across unrelated pages.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use lists, comparisons, steps, product demos or editorial blocks.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Equal cards work for genuinely comparable items.

antiPatterns.name: Split hero as universal default
antiPatterns.summary: Text-left/image-right hero selected before content analysis.
antiPatterns.trigger: No product/task reason supports the split.
antiPatterns.impact: Hero may fail to demonstrate product or story.
antiPatterns.alternative: Compare product-led, typographic, full-bleed, search-first and narrative options.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Split works when message and visual need separate space.

antiPatterns.name: Decorative floating orbs
antiPatterns.summary: Unrelated blurred blobs or circles used as filler.
antiPatterns.trigger: Shapes have no connection to product or interaction.
antiPatterns.impact: Attention is consumed by generic decoration.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use product artifacts, diagrams, typography or relevant geometry.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Abstract forms can be a deliberate identity.

antiPatterns.name: Icon soup
antiPatterns.summary: Generic icons added to every heading and label.
antiPatterns.trigger: Icons repeat text without meaning or status value.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use icons for recognizable action/status and pair with labels.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Dense UI may need a controlled pictogram set.

antiPatterns.name: Badge confetti
antiPatterns.summary: Excessive badges and pills.
antiPatterns.trigger: Many items have accent labels without information difference.
antiPatterns.alternative: Reserve badges for meaningful metadata or state.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Controlled status vocabulary can aid tables.

antiPatterns.name: Monotone spacing
antiPatterns.summary: Same gap used for unrelated relationships.
antiPatterns.trigger: Heading/body and section/section gaps are similar.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use spacing scale with relationship-specific gaps.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Compact data grid can have consistent row spacing.

antiPatterns.name: Microtext everywhere
antiPatterns.summary: Secondary text is tiny/faint to look premium.
antiPatterns.trigger: Labels and helper text are hard to read.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use clear type roles and contrast; remove unnecessary copy.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Non-critical metadata may be smaller if legible.

antiPatterns.name: Oversized hero copy without purpose
antiPatterns.summary: Huge headline overwhelms regardless of surface mode.
antiPatterns.trigger: Primary task/product is pushed below fold.
antiPatterns.alternative: Set type scale from brand, content and task.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Expressive campaign may use display as artifact.

antiPatterns.name: Empty product mockup
antiPatterns.summary: Generic fake UI replaces actual product proof.
antiPatterns.trigger: Mockup contains meaningless placeholder widgets.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use real screen, labelled prototype or authentic artifact.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Concepts may use illustrative UI if marked.

antiPatterns.name: Fabricated social proof
antiPatterns.summary: Invented quotes, logos, counts or ratings.
antiPatterns.trigger: Trust content has no source.
antiPatterns.impact: It misleads and creates product/legal risk.
antiPatterns.alternative: Omit it, request real proof or label placeholder.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Fictional examples must be unmistakably fictional.

antiPatterns.name: Decorative divider noise
antiPatterns.summary: Lines separate every content group.
antiPatterns.trigger: Borders appear where spacing/surface already groups.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use whitespace, grouping and surface shifts.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Tables and inputs may need boundaries.

antiPatterns.name: Motion confetti
antiPatterns.summary: Many unrelated entrance, hover and scroll animations.
antiPatterns.trigger: Motion repeats without state/narrative purpose.
antiPatterns.impact: It distracts, harms performance or excludes.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use few coherent motion families with reduced-motion fallback.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Experience-first work may use coordinated motion.

antiPatterns.name: Hover-only information
antiPatterns.summary: Critical action/label appears only on hover.
antiPatterns.trigger: Keyboard and touch cannot reveal it.
antiPatterns.alternative: Provide persistent labels and keyboard/touch alternatives.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Non-essential previews may remain optional.

antiPatterns.name: Fake live status
antiPatterns.summary: Pulsing dots/counters imply live data without source.
antiPatterns.trigger: Freshness, source or cadence is unknown.
antiPatterns.impact: Users mistake decoration for operational truth.
antiPatterns.alternative: Remove live cues or label demo data.
antiPatterns.exceptions: A labelled prototype can illustrate a live state.

antiPatterns.name: Inconsistent radius language
antiPatterns.summary: Unrelated corner radii without component rationale.
antiPatterns.trigger: Controls and cards use arbitrary values.
antiPatterns.alternative: Define semantic radius roles and exceptions.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Component families may have different radii.

antiPatterns.name: One-size-fits-all dashboard
antiPatterns.summary: Identical metric cards/charts regardless of user task.
antiPatterns.trigger: No clear question or action organizes the dashboard.
antiPatterns.impact: It becomes a generic wall of metrics.
antiPatterns.alternative: Organize by decisions, data freshness and drill-down.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Monitoring overview may use purposeful metric tiles.

antiPatterns.name: Placeholder-only labels
antiPatterns.summary: Placeholder stands in as the only field label.
antiPatterns.trigger: Field purpose disappears after typing.
antiPatterns.impact: Users lose context and accessible naming clarity.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use persistent label and helper/error text.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Search may use accessible name with contextual prompt.

antiPatterns.name: Unbounded content width
antiPatterns.summary: Text and forms stretch across wide viewports.
antiPatterns.trigger: Paragraphs/fields span viewport without purpose.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use readable measure and grid constraints.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Wide diagrams/tables may need width.

antiPatterns.name: Trend stack
antiPatterns.summary: Several current trends combined without a visual thesis.
antiPatterns.trigger: Glass, gradient, bento, pills and huge type compete.
antiPatterns.impact: Identity feels assembled rather than directed.
antiPatterns.alternative: Choose one dominant thesis and compatible supporting patterns.
antiPatterns.exceptions: Collage can be coherent when deliberate.
